revisions_and_findings.mcp_tasks: MCP Tasks supports post-receipt durable continuation but does not by itself close pre-taskId response-loss ambiguity. Official C# SDK v2.2.0 makes the gap concrete: IMcpTaskStore.CreateTaskAsync has no original-request/idempotency argument; task creation and background execution precede CreateTaskResult return. Its convenient in-memory store is not restart-durable, and auto-polling keeps taskId only in local method state.
